2026-10-23-1.title: The project list
2026-10-23-1.body: Now the project list shows 3 pictures of the people. A number after them, such as +2, counts the rest.

2026-10-23-2.title: Your profile photo
2026-10-23-2.body: Now a photo with a see-through background shows your glow behind it. Upload the photo again to see the glow.

2026-10-23-3.title: The calendar on a computer
2026-10-23-3.body: Now the calendar on a computer moves one month for each step of the mouse wheel.

2026-10-23-4.title: Archive a chat
2026-10-23-4.body: Now you can archive a chat. A new message brings it back.

2026-10-23-5.title: Group chats
2026-10-23-5.body: Now you can make a group chat with 2 or more people. Press New message, then Make a group.

2026-10-23-6.title: Agents read your chats
2026-10-23-6.body: Now your AI agent can read your chats. It can also list the chats that wait for your reply.

2026-10-23-7.title: Sub-companies
2026-10-23-7.body: Now the Admin can add the sub-companies of the office, each with a logo. A project picks its sub-company, and the logo shows beside the project picture.

2026-10-23-8.title: The project on the map
2026-10-23-8.body: Now you can pin the project on a map in the project settings. Search a place by name or paste a map link. The Dashboard has a Map tab with all the pins.

2026-10-23-9.title: Open space
2026-10-23-9.body: Now Open space shows the office as a mind map of projects, stages and tasks. Open it from the Dashboard.

2026-10-23-10.title: Project templates
2026-10-23-10.body: Now the Admin can drag the stages of a project template, copy a template, see its timeline, and send an update to the projects made from it.

2026-10-23-11.title: Roles and rights
2026-10-23-11.body: Now the Admin can make a custom role and choose its rights.

2026-10-23-12.title: The office report
2026-10-23-12.body: Now a person with the report right can ask an AI agent for the full office report.
